# vcp_llm_models (Data Source)

Lists the LLM model catalog of the project. The list is empty until the project is connected to the LLM service (`vcp_llm_connection`). Prices of a model are in `vcp_llm_model`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vcp_llm_models" "catalog" {}

# Inference address of every model the groups may call, by model name.
output "llm_endpoints" {
  value = {
    for m in data.vcp_llm_models.catalog.models : m.tech_title => m.endpoint
    if m.is_available_to_groups
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `models` (Attributes List) Catalog models. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))
- `prices_collected_at` (String) When the prices were last collected from the providers, RFC 3339.

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `context_size` (Number) Context size, in tokens.
- `contour` (String) `local` for a model served in the local contour, `external` for an external provider.
- `description` (String) Description, in English.
- `endpoint` (String) Inference address of the model.
- `id` (Number) Model ID, for `model_ids` of `vcp_llm_group`.
- `is_available_to_groups` (Boolean) Whether the model can be granted to a group.
- `is_pii_protected` (Boolean) Whether personal data in the calls is protected.
- `kind` (String) Model kind: `text`, `rag`, `speech`, `image` or `video`. New kinds may be added over time.
- `name` (String) Display name, in English.
- `storage_countries` (List of String) Countries the data of the calls is stored in.
- `tech_title` (String) Model name the inference calls take in the `model` field.
- `unit_kind` (String) Unit the model is billed in: `tokens`, `units`, `bytes` or `none`.
- `vendor` (String) Model vendor.
